items.statement: Among adults with type 2 diabetes and HbA1c of 58 mmol/mol or more, offering group medical visits instead of individual reviews lowers HbA1c at 12 months by at least 4 mmol/mol.
items.rationale: The target difference matches the pooled trial effect and is large enough to justify expansion; feasibility depends on recruiting enough patients across practices.
items.risks: Attendance, shared clinicians and too few eligible patients in one practice.

items.statement: Group visits reduce diabetes distress more than individual reviews.
items.rationale: Supported by the general practice trial's secondary result.
